title: Animal Passport 0.1
description: passport.json in an Animal Passport package. Readers ignore properties they do not recognize, so this schema allows them; a writer should put its own values in extensions.

records.description: The records, by record type. Every key is optional.

identifiers.description: Names, tags, transponders and other identifiers. The primary identifier is always shipped, even when the sender did not choose this type.

populations.description: For a group or colony, the current count by life stage.

cases.description: Veterinary cases. Clinical notes refer to them with caseRef.

labCollections.description: Sample collections, samples, tests and findings.

medicalAlerts.description: Alerts for people working with the animal.

physiologicalReadings.description: Physiological readings such as heart rate.

transactions.description: Acquisitions, dispositions, moves, births and deaths.

date.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, never shifted between time zones.

dateTime.description: ISO 8601 local date and time with its UTC offset, for example 2026-08-18T13:34:37-10:00.

audit.description: The creation date-time, one space, then the creator's name as the source writes it.

decimal.description: A number written as decimal text, so no precision is lost.

text.description: HTML or plain text. The reader decides which from the content.

originRef.description: An opaque record identity. Compare for equality; never parse.

fileName.description: The name of a file in the package's media/ folder.

population.description: A count as males.females.unknown, for example 1.0.2.

populationChange.description: Animals involved, as males.females.unknown; a count may be negative where it is a change.

amount.description: A measured amount. The value is decimal text (text for a non-numeric lab result); the unit is UCUM where the writer knows the code, otherwise the source's spelling.

rate.description: An amount per unit, for example 5 mg per kg.

rating.description: A rating: the source's score and its label. Either may be absent.

facility.description: A facility: its name, and its code and mnemonic when known. At least one of the three is present; the name should be.

animals.description: On a record that covers more than one animal: how many, and up to ten of their local identifiers, the exported animal first.

extensions.description: Values only the writing system understands, under a namespace named for that system. Readers ignore namespaces they do not know.

schedule.description: A repeating schedule, shared by dose frequencies and diet meals.

doseDuration.description: How long a dose continues: a value in days, doses or weeks, or until further notice.

Manifest.description: The manifest: what the file is, who wrote it and what it contains.

specVersion.description: The version of this specification the file follows.

transferBatchKey.description: A UUID identifying this package. A reader can use it to refuse importing the same package twice.

exportedBy.description: The person who exported it, as the source system writes the name.

originSoftware.description: The system that wrote the file.

holderFacility.description: The facility holding the animal when the passport was written. Expected; absent only when the source does not know it.

contents.description: One row for every record type the file carries, and for every type the sender chose to share even when it has no records. A record type the sender did not share is absent.

recordCount.description: How many records of that type the file carries. For a grouped type (`measurements`, `enrichment`, `training`) it counts the `records`, not the configuration beside them. 0 means the type was shared and the animal has none.

Core.description: Who the animal is. Always present.

gan.description: The animal's Global Accession Number, when it has one. At least one of `localId` and `gan` is required.

localId.description: The holder's local identifier for the animal. At least one of `localId` and `gan` is required.

currentSex.description: The current sex, as the source writes it (for example `Female`).

animalType.description: Whether the record is one animal, a group or a colony.

population.description: The current count as males.females.unknown: for an individual `1.0.0`, `0.1.0` or `0.0.1`; for a group or colony, its members.

rank.description: The taxonomic rank of that name (for example `Species`, `Subspecies`).

scheme.description: The database: `itis` or `gbif`. Other public schemes may be added in later versions.

birthDate.description: The best single date of birth or hatch.

birthDateEarliest.description: The earliest the date can be. Equal to `birthDate` when the date is exact; `null` when there is no lower bound.

birthDateLatest.description: The latest the date can be; `null` when there is no upper bound.

hybrid.description: Hybrid status, as the source writes it.

birthInstitution.description: Where the animal was born or hatched.

current.description: `live`, `preBirth` or `dead`. A value outside these is shipped as the source holds it.

initial.description: The state the record began in, with the same values.

SexRecord.description: A dated determination of the animal's sex.

originRef.description: The record's identity in the system that first recorded it. Opaque: compare it for equality, never parse it. See originRef.

recordDateTime.description: When the sex was determined or recorded.

sex.description: The sex, as the source writes it.

recordedAt.description: Where the record was made, when that is not the exporting holder. See recordedAt.
